programme.title: The Gift Of Christmas
programme.desc: Christmastime at the home of George and Denise Barnett look festive, but all is not well - George is worried about a friend and Denise over the Christmas concert at their church. Solutions don't come easily but on Christmas Eve everyone is reminded of the true gift of Christmas.

programme.title: The Christmas Project
programme.desc: Four fed-up brothers join forces during Christmastime to get payback against the Hagbarts -- the meanest bullies at their middle school.

programme.title: A Christmas Dance Reunion
programme.desc: A successful attorney, Lucy is reunited with her childhood Christmas dance partner Barrett, as the pair give a resort a new lease on life and the passion between the pair heats up.

programme.title: Christmas In Paris
programme.desc: Lucas, a wealthy French entrepreneur, heads to Montana for a very attractive business proposal. When there he meets Robin, falls in love, and whisks her away to Paris on a whirlwind Christmas Adventure. But will business bring an end to this romance?

programme.title: Enchanting Christmas
programme.desc: At Christmas the daughter of an ice sculptor wishes the ice princess he carved would come to life. After her wish is fulfilled, Jade, the ice princess, must convince her scultpor to accept her or she will turn back into ice.

programme.title: Christmas On 5th Avenue
programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Eva Jordan loves everything about Christmas. This year as she decorates a spectacular Manhattan Penthouse for Christmas, bubbly Eva Jordan brings moody writer Lucas Blade some joy for the holidays.

programme.title: Christmas Lucky Charm
programme.desc: Jessica Connolly becomes a good luck charm when each of her ex-boyfriends finds his perfect match right after dating her and is married by Christmas.
